The '''hair trigger''' was a modification made to [[Pistol/Legends|pistols]], [[Rifle/Legends|rifles]] and heavy weapons that used a trigger mechanism to fire. The hair trigger accessory made it easier to fire several shots in quick succession by reducing the amount of pressure that must be placed on the trigger. This works as a two-stage system. The initial depression of the trigger set the weapon to 'ready', while the second would fire it. The second stage would require little pressure to activate.
